Alex — thanks for the clear brief. Drafting a MAP now; I attached a workbook (AVH_MAP_v1.xlsx) and an initial acceptance-tests.md. Key notes up front:

- Pilot length: 3 weeks (configurable to 4 if we need deeper QA).
- Exit gates we propose: security review pass (security questionnaire + infra logs), data ingestion sanity checks, model quality smoke tests (precision/recall proxies), latency SLOs, and handoff readiness for Dedicated if successful.
- Acceptance tests: automated prompt-set concordance, spot-check edge-case suite, latency distribution report, and a small human evaluation (20 randomized samples).

Action items for AtlasView: confirm the de-identification process and share an initial 500-sample prompt set (we saw your sample-prompt-set.jsonl). We propose milestone-based signoffs at day 7 (ingest & infra), day 14 (quality smoke tests), day 21 (final acceptance + go/no-go).

Sending the workbook and acceptance tests now. Ben — can you add the pricing milestone (credit/discount) language we discussed? Lauren — can you own QA coordination and the human eval?

Jordan
